title: Directory reorganization: lib/mitosis rename and docs merge

completion_criteria.text: The blast radius is re-derived as a closed census over the CURRENT tree that halts on anything unclassifiable, and every difference from 0340's 17-site count is explained rather than absorbed.
lib/superpowers-parallel becomes lib/mitosis and resolve-superpowers.mjs becomes superpowers-prompts.mjs, every load-bearing path string changing in the SAME commit.
docs/superpowers/{specs,plans} merge into the existing docs/{specs,plans}, and workflows/parallel-plan-execution.js becomes mitosis-execute.js together with its meta.name.
The dead .gitignore line is deleted rather than renamed, since it names a path nothing writes.
Behaviour-neutrality is proven by execution not inspection: drift-check hook, CI phase-parity, npm test glob, pr.mjs imports and mitosis.js LIB_DIR all resolve after the move.
A PR is opened through the centralized pr-create tool from a worktree branch, the primary checkout never leaves main, and phase 2 subdivision is left undone.

closure_statement: The lib/mitosis rename shipped through PR #64, converge.mjs auto-promoted it on the fast-forward, and live release 1ecacc7 was verified to carry the renamed tree with drift-check exiting 0; the CUTOVER question this thread raised is answered and carried to child thread 01KZS8WH39NCYM3S8VRFQNJPNB under decision 0346.

spine.active_goal: The rename is merged, promoted and verified live, with all six criteria met. A separate defect in the CUTOVER journal was uncovered by the final step and needs its own work.
spine.next_step: START HERE FRESH. The rename is DONE and needs nothing. Open a new thread for the CUTOVER journal defect described in the first open risk. Check first whether the rollback path reads CUTOVER, since 0323 established rollback reads release state - if it does, a rollback could target the wrong release. Then return to the parent thread 01KZQ2BVF2386ATV5YFD43NQVX for SPEC B scoping.
spine.last_session: PR #64 merged; converge.mjs auto-promoted on the fast-forward so the pointer move was the whole cutover. Verified live: current is 1ecacc7, the resolver exists, the old dir is gone, drift-check exits 0. The user ran the blocked apply by hand; it was a no-op that left the journal unwritten.

open_risks.text: Read ~/.claude/CUTOVER as WRONG rather than merely stale — it names releases/75b90a3 as current while the real symlink and LIVE both say 1ecacc7, and apply cannot fix it because it returns before writing whenever every entry is already linked

Check whether the rollback path consults CUTOVER before trusting rollback at all — 0323 established rollback reads the release rather than the repo, so a journal naming the wrong release directory could send a rollback to the wrong target

Expect converge.mjs to promote on its own whenever the checkout drifts from main — it is registered on SessionStart and Stop, so a merge promotes without anyone running promote, which is what closed the rename hazard before the operator reached apply

Treat the prior 17-site enumeration as disproven rather than incomplete — the real census was 31 lines across 18 files, and the miss included a guard regex whose loss would have been silent with every test still green

key_decisions.title: The stale superpowers-parallel tree is renamed to lib/mitosis as a pure move before the SPEC
The rename executes in a worktree with the blast radius re-derived rather than trusted
Merging the rename and running the cutover are one operation, not two

out_of_scope: Phase 2 subdivision of lib/mitosis into engine, recovery, git and gates
Reconciling the diverged root-level docs/superpowers tree
